_comment: Hand-entered application deadlines, applied on top of whatever the ATS sync finds.
Most bank early-career deadlines are announced on the firm's own careers page or
in an email to campus, never in the ATS record, so no amount of scraping will
find them. This file is where a date you know goes.
Matching: `id` is exact and wins. Otherwise `firm` plus `rolePattern` (a
case-insensitive substring of the role title) applies to every matching role,
which is what you want when a bank runs one deadline across a whole programme.
`closingDate` must be ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). `source` is not used by the site; it is
there so the next person can tell where the date came from and re-check it.
Entries whose date has passed are ignored, so stale rows are harmless.
